basic_info.description: Large Pacific Heights Victorian home with many gorgeous period details. Soaring Ceilings.  Gracious entry. Glorious staircase. Beautiful light. Luscious wood paneling. Hidden passageways. Deep lot. Large basement. Spacious kitchen that walks out directly to backyard. 2660 California is an architecturally unique home that has been loved for many years by the same family. You can feel the home's history as you go from one room to the next. Ideal location steps to Alta Plaza park and the shops on Fillmore Street. This is a tremendous opportunity to own and remake a piece of SF's past.
